_README: PLACEHOLDER DATA for the University of North Texas. Structure is real, numbers are not. Stage 3 replaces tuition and credits_required with figures from UNT's published tuition schedule and undergraduate catalog, with exact URLs and effective dates. Stage 4 replaces the salary block with College Scorecard field-of-study earnings under an honest metric name. Every figure keeps its OWN source/source_date pair — a credit requirement must never cite a salary dataset.
